notes.title: Fiendish detective game The Case of the Golden Idol enhanced with huge update
notes.content:
I could never hack it as a detective but I like to think my sleuthing skills have been somewhat honed through years of playing puzzle and adventure games. The true test for these faculties, other than titles like Discworld Noir or Return of the Obra Dinn, is The Case of the Golden Idol. Two years after launch and ahead of its sequel's release this detective sim has been spruced up with a brand new free upgrade that makes it much smoother to play.

Read the rest of the story...

RELATED LINKS:
Hit adventure game The Case of the Golden Idol to get big free update

notes.title: The Case of the Golden Idol - Redux update available now!
notes.content:
Last week we announced a new update coming to The Case of the Golden Idol - called Redux. Learn more about that announcement here: https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1677770/view/4677641741933164088

The update is available today for all current (and future) owners of The Case of the Golden Idol. You should be prompted to update the next time you launch the game, and choose either the classic or Redux version to launch. While this update features no new playable cases or scenarios, it introduces a number of new features that make it a smoother experience overall. We understand that some players may prefer the "classic" version free of these changes, which is why we are shipping this as an optional launch parameter for all players.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1677770/The_Case_of_the_Golden_Idol/

Here are some highlights from the Redux update.

[h3]12 supported languages:[/h3]
English (US)
French
Italian 
German
Spanish (Latin America)
Spanish (Spain)
Portuguese (Brazil)
Japanese
Korean 
Polish
Turkish
Chinese (Traditional)

*Chinese (Simplified) will be made available at a later date. 

[h3]New UI & Hint System[/h3]
Returning players should notice an overhaul to the UI, which should improve readability and navigation, especially at smaller resolutions. Additionally, there are now markers that indicate what objects can be interacted with, so no more guessing or using guides when you get stuck.


[h3]Steam Deck Support[/h3]
Support for Steam Deck is now in beta. In addition to running smoother, the UI and text should now scale to appropriately fit the screen size. Once the review process completes, The Case of the Golden Idol will be listed as a Verified title on the store and in your library, a process we expect to take a few weeks.

[b]For Nintendo Switch Owners[/b] - The new release of The Case of the Golden Idol: Complete Edition will need to be manually claimed on the Nintendo eShop, and is free for all current owners. This rerelease includes all of the above changes and addresses an infrequent issue that caused some players to lose all save progress.


[h2]Moving Forward[/h2]
Today, we also announced that the sequel, The Rise of the Golden Idol, will be launching on all platforms on November 12, 2024. Check out the release date trailer here for a sneak peak at what's coming next.

[previewyoutube=BlOOlkAc4N4;full][/previewyoutube]

And for those who can't wait, we also released a new extended demo ahead of Steam Next Fest, available to play right now.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2716400/The_Rise_of_the_Golden_Idol/

Lastly - thank you for the ongoing support over the past couple years. We can't wait for everyone to check out The Rise of the Golden Idol when it releases next month. Wishlist, follow, tell a friend, etc.

- Team Idol

notes.title: Announcing The Case of the Golden Idol Redux
notes.content:
Hello Detectives,

A lot has happened since the original release of [i]The Case of the Golden Idol[/i] back in 2022. Outside of two DLC expansions, we released home console ports on Xbox Series, PlayStation 5, and Nintendo Switch. Additionally, through our partnership with Netflix, we brought all available Golden Idol content to mobile devices.

Along the way, a lot of improvements were made to the original game as a result of porting the game to a new engine. An overhaul to the UI, a new hint system, 13 new localizations, readability and save improvements, and dozens more quality-of-life changes make [i]The Case of the Golden Idol[/i] a much more seamless and enjoyable experience to play, especially on Steam Deck.

In the spirit of making sure every version of [i]The Case of the Golden Idol[/i] is the definitive version to play, on October 10 we will ship a free update that will provide all of these enhancements to the original Golden Idol experience on Steam. All owners of [i]The Case of the Golden Idol[/i] will receive the Redux version completely free of charge, and will be included in all future purchases of the game.

[h3]Steam[/h3]
[b]After this update is live, players will receive a prompt when launching the game asking which version they wish to play - The original version as it is currently, or the Redux release which includes the improvements made above. [/b]Additionally, you can transfer your progress from the original to the Redux version, so detectives can pick up after the last case that has been completed. 

[h3]Console[/h3]
The Nintendo Switch version of the game will be delisted and no longer available for purchase on October 9, and replaced with this new Redux rerelease. Anyone that owns or purchases the current version of Case on this platform before this date will retain the ability to play this version, and will be granted the Redux release of the Complete Edition free of charge - although the Switch version does not include support for save transfer. The Xbox Series and PlayStation 5 releases are built on this Redux framework, so nothing will change here.

We hope that the addition of these features, new languages, and better support for Steam Deck will allow more players to experience [i]The Case of the Golden Idol[/i]. 

Lastly, don’t forget to wishlist and follow [i]The Rise of the Golden Idol[/i], we will have some big announcements to share very soon.

- Team Idol

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2716400/The_Rise_of_the_Golden_Idol/

notes.title: DLC support added for macOS users!
notes.content:
Hey detectives,

The latest patch adds DLC support for macOS players! We're happy to announce that Mac players can now enjoy solving the three new cases in [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2377000/Golden_Idol_Mysteries_The_Spider_of_Lanka/]Golden Idol Mysteries: The Spider of Lanka[/url][/b].

[quote][b]Notice for macOS users:[/b]
Due to revisions we made on the Mac version, old save files from before the update will need to be copied over manually. Please follow these recovery instructions for MacOS:
[olist]
[*] Locate the following folder:
~/Library/Application Support/Godot/app_userdata/The Case of The Golden Idol/
[*] Find file local_savegame.save and a file with your steamid (long string of numbers) followed by savegame.save (example: 76562187998383791_savegame.save)
[*] Open local_savegame.save in any text editor and copy its contents over everything in the savegame starting with your steam id.
[*] Save this file and you should now have a functioning savegame that the game will read.
[/olist][/quote]
Thank you to our fans on macOS for your patience.

[i]Note: We're aware of achievement and performance issues related to MacBook models with the Apple M1 processor and are investigating the matter. We appreciate your patience.[/i]

Please feel free to let us know your feedback in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1677770/discussions/0/]discussions[/url] or in our [url=https://discord.gg/2kDZAxbKuC]Discord[/url].

notes.title: 💀 Our first DLC has landed!
notes.content:
Detectives, today's the day. 

We are very excited (and terrified) to launch the first ever expansion for [i]The Case of the Golden Idol[/i]. 

It's live now! Take a look: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2377000/Golden_Idol_Mysteries_The_Spider_of_Lanka/

(Also we're launching it at a 10% discount).  

The new DLC - called [i]Golden Idol Mysteries: The Spider of Lanka[/i] - offers three brand new scenarios to untangle. 

Here's a trailer showing a little more: 

[previewyoutube=alvseVf4sf0;full][/previewyoutube]

We've been testing the game with super-fans and volunteer testers [url=https://discord.com/invite/98EZEuEqK8]on our Discord[/url], and we are extremely happy with the very useful feedback. 

Our aim is to provide players with some of our most challenging murder cases yet - do let us know if you think we've pulled it off. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41022700/4c2fe39069c94e2b5694edae1ac116659e62cae3.gif[/img]

In [i]The Spider of Lanka[/i] there will be familiar faces for sure, but for this DLC we wanted to take the story far farther afield from the rainy hills of Blackfield. 

Instead, you'll be transported to an ancient kingdom in a state of transition. Here, you can delve deeper into complex personalities and conflicting motives at play as you scour the courtyards, throne rooms, dockyards and back alleys for clues behind the grander mystery. 

We hope you'll enjoy this expedition to Lanka and that the new scenarios will satisfy your Detective brain!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41022700/4b2de4ace65162cdfb0cf08628969657839bc5c8.gif[/img]

[i]Golden Idol Mysteries: The Spider of Lanka is available for Windows now. The Mac version will be released on a later date.[/i]

Love, 

 [b]- Andrejs & Ernests[/b]

notes.title: Betrayal at Club Low wins grand prize at Independent Games Festival award show

notes.title: Update 2022.12.05 v1.3.3

Hey detectives,

notes.title: Stability fixes and text improvements - version 1.3.2
notes.content:
Hey detectives, 

The following issues are addressed in this patch based on player feedback since the release.

[b]Hidden phrase checking[/b]
We have fixed a rare condition where a phrase may become hidden under another phrase in the inventory. The game now checks phrase positions to make sure that if any phrase overlaps another, it will move that phrase to the next free slot in the inventory.

[b]Corrupt save file detection[/b]
We’ve had rare cases where player save files were corrupted by the OS. If the game detects a corrupted save, the player will be invited to visit a helpful savegame repository with instructions on how to recover progress.

[b]Small fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed typo in Act 2 name "Cursed Inheritence" -> Inheritance
[*]Scenario 7 third letter: "brothehood" -> "brotherhood".
[*]Fixed bracket position in the epilogue brotherhood scroll for Willard Wright. (it previously went out of the paper background)
[*]Fixed that you can switch around Alistair and James' surnames in the epilogue third scroll and still be correct.
[*]Fixed that if you are zoomed in, the screen position is broken when you return to the scenario selection screen.
[*]Added hyphens to the will text in the 3rd Scenario. Should be “My late sister - your mother - …”
[/list]

Please feel free to let us know your feedback in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1677770/discussions/0/]discussions[/url] or in our [url=https://discord.gg/2kDZAxbKuC]Discord[/url].

notes.title: The Case Of The Golden Idol review: a gripping detective game with echoes of Obra Dinn
notes.content:
Detective games are often about filling in the blanks. A terrible crime will sit at the heart of them, yes, but most take place in the days and weeks that follow, where the bulk of your time is spent gathering clues and building a case to work out whodunnit. Rarely do you get to glimpse the immediate aftermath of the crime itself, where all the major suspects are still in play and their pockets are stuffed with incriminating evidence they'll no doubt be disposing of in the coming minutes.

The prime exception to this rule is Lucas Pope's Return Of The Obra Dinn, which gives you a time-travelling pocket watch to revisit the scenes of its many, many murders and work out exactly what happened to its 60-strong passenger list on its titular, ill-fated ship. Frogwares' Sherlock Holmes games and their mind palace visualisation techniques also warrant a mention here, and maybe even Outer Wilds at a push, if you count its 22-minute timeloop as an investigation scene several millennia in the making. But it's Obra Dinn that Color Gray Games emulate most strongly with their impressive debut in The Case Of The Golden Idol, which gives you a series of 12 murders to solve, each of which is presented as a freeze-frame vignette at the moment of death. You're still filling in blanks here, slotting names, objects and eventually verbs in its various scene scrolls to deduce whodunnit and howtheydunit, but this intriguing tale of 18th century high (and a secret) society, betrayals, backstabbing and murder most foul is a mystery game for the ages.

Read more

notes.title: The Case of the Golden Idol is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41022700/1116e5bdb992dc366cbb4940ee1b0505cf4d288c.gif[/img][h3]The Case of the Golden Idol is available NOW![/h3]

Hey Detectives, 

Today is the day! It has been a long journey and we are so excited to announce that The Case of the Golden Idol is now available on PC! 


The Case of the Golden Idol is a narrative detective game set in an alternate 18th-century England where players must investigate 12 most strange and gruesome deaths spanning forty years. Something awful connects these tragedies, providing a wider mystery for the player to unravel. 


Each case is presented as a snapshot scene frozen in time. Players can freely search through these scenes in whichever fashion they choose to deduce the suspect, motive, and chronology of events. The player’s theory is then placed into an interactive notepad, which in turn will inform the player whether their theory is correct or not.

notes.title: Investigate 18th century murders in The Case Of The Golden Idol demo
notes.content:
The Case Of The Golden Idol is a detective game in which you explore 2D scenes of grisly murders. As you click around, you'll discover new words to add to your inventory, which you can then use to fill in your explanation of the crime. How did who get into whose room, which person was killed, and how did the murder take place?

These are the sorts of questions you'll be answering across 12 different murders - and there's a demo available now, if you want to start to work the case right away.
